• Status: proposed
  • Date: YYYY-MM-DD
  • Decision owners: name or team
  • Scope: system, platform or repository
  • Supersedes: none
  • Superseded by: none

Context

Describe the requirement, constraint or problem that makes this decision necessary. Include current operating conditions, known scale, reliability, security or cost needs. Avoid describing a solution before the problem.

Decision Drivers

  • Driver one.
  • Driver two.
  • Operational constraint or measurable requirement.

Considered Options

Option A: Chosen or Candidate Approach

Describe the approach briefly.

Advantages

  • Benefit tied to a driver.

Disadvantages

  • Cost, risk or operating burden.

Option B: Alternative

Describe a realistic alternative and why it may or may not be suitable.

Advantages

  • Benefit.

Disadvantages

  • Cost or limitation.

Decision

State the chosen option directly and the scope in which it applies.

Consequences

Positive

  • Expected benefit.

Negative

  • Accepted cost, limitation or failure mode.

Operational

  • Deployment, monitoring, recovery, security or ownership implications.

Validation and Review

Define signals or milestones that will validate the decision and conditions that should trigger reconsideration.

Review trigger:

References

  • Link to relevant issue, diagram, operational documentation or external guidance.
